limitations: Each source/cohort has one first-open observation only, sequential baseline then candidate, with warm OS caches. These are descriptive upgrade costs, not p50/p95 or a speed gate.
The allocated index reuses free database pages in both copied old archives. Zero observed file growth does not mean the index is free: 200704/151552 bytes are allocated to it.

The ru_maxrss fields are process high-water marks and may retain launcher/fork high-water usage. The identical values between sources do not establish equal live RSS or zero memory overhead. Use the formal worker resource measurements for memory assessment.
